messages:
Alisa: Quick heads-up — we need a fast sweep of partner tier buckets this week and a line-itemized MDF breakdown (marketplace credits, HW co-funding, SI enablement). Can folks confirm availability to pull numbers and agree on column layout?

Matt S: I can take the sheet. Do we have a canonical template or should I spin up a new tab in Partner-ops?

Jordan K: Use the partner-ops/template-v3 spreadsheet (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEF). I added a clean tab for MDF line items last quarter.

Samira R: I'll pull last Q allocations + actual spend vs committed. Also have partner-use cases to tag (marketplace, hw, si).

Alisa: Perfect. For scorecards we also want to add enablement hours and joint-announcement readiness as explicit columns. Draft CSV header below — LMK if anything missing: 

```
partner,tier,bucket,mdf_usd,hw_credit_usd,si_enable_hours,go_to_market_ready,announce_window,notes
```

Matt S: That looks good. Suggest adding `agreement_id` and `last_payment_date` for reconciliation.

Jordan K: +1 on `agreement_id`. Also will add formulas for total MDF per tier and a pivot-friendly `category` column.

Samira R: Accounting asked whether marketplace credits should be treated as discount or MDF for reporting. I think we tag them with `mdf_type=marketplace_credit` so finance can map.

Alisa: Good call — add `mdf_type` and `acct_tag` columns. Also policy note: propose capping co-fund at 50% for Bronze and 75% for Silver; Gold/Strategic reviewed case-by-case. Can legal/finance sign off quickly?

Matt S: I'll add policy rows and scenario tabs (base / stretched) to show impact to budget. Working on the formulas now.

Jordan K: Quick automation idea — set up a small Apps Script that flags rows missing `announce_window` and emails owners. Pasting minimal snippet: 

```
function flagMissingAnnounce() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById('1abcDEF');
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName('mdf-line-items');
  // ... iterate rows and send email if announce_window blank
}
```

Samira R: Nice. I'll coordinate with PMM for announce windows and provide copy for QBR slide notes.

ops-bot: Reminder: Quarterly partner review deck due in 4 days. /deadline add 4d #qbr-deck

Alisa: Action items summarised: Matt — create sheet + policy rows + scenarios. Jordan — formulas, pivot, Apps Script. Samira — historical pulls + PMM coordination. Finance/legal — please review cap policy by EOD tomorrow.

Matt S: On it. Will post the initial tab here when ready. :thumbsup:

Jordan K: I'll try to get automations in place by EOD.

Samira R: Pulling historicals now, will post a short readout.

Alisa: Thanks team — want a quick sync in 30 if anyone is free to walk through the columns? Otherwise we'll triage async.

Matt S: I can hop in 30.

Jordan K: Busy for 30, will follow up async.

Samira R: Free.

Alisa: Cool — meeting if Matt + Samira, otherwise async update by EOD. Reminder to add `acct_tag` and `mdf_type` on every row.

Matt S: uploaded first draft: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEF/edit#gid=123 (tab: MDF-line-items-draft) — comments invited.

Jordan K: Left a couple inline comments on formula ranges.

Samira R: Added historical spend tab and a small note about partner X (they used only 40% of their MDF last quarter).

Alisa: Great progress. We'll lock numbers tomorrow AM and finalize the scorecard metrics for the QBR deck. :party_parrot:
